_note: Post 10221 rebuilt. Every title now names laser hair removal so the card stands alone in Google Images. The before/after card is split into two labelled panels, neutral tone, because preparation and aftercare are different groups rather than opposed ones.

cards.subject: laser hair removal
cards.heading: How many laser hair removal sessions do most people need?
title: Laser Hair Removal:
How Many Sessions
cards.alt: Most people need six to nine laser hair removal sessions, spaced about six weeks apart
cards.statLine: laser hair removal sessions for the best result, not the one or two most people expect
cards.source: American Society for Laser Medicine and Surgery

cards.subject: laser hair removal
cards.heading: How many sessions for legs, underarms, bikini, and face?
title: Laser Hair Removal
by Area
cards.alt: Laser hair removal session counts by area: underarms, bikini and legs 6 to 8, back, chest and face 8 or more

cards.subject: laser hair removal
cards.heading: Does hair color change how many sessions you need?
title: Hair Color and
Laser Hair Removal
cards.alt: Laser targets pigment, so dark coarse hair responds well while gray, white, red and blonde do not

bad.heading: Responds poorly
items: Too little pigment to absorb light

cards.subject: laser hair removal
cards.heading: What should you do before and after a session?
title: Laser Hair Removal
Prep and Aftercare
cards.alt: Before laser hair removal shave and avoid waxing and sun; after, skip heat for 24 hours and use sunscreen

good.heading: Before your session
items: Shave the area the day before
No waxing or plucking for 4 weeks

bad.heading: After your session
items: Expect redness for a day or two
No hot tubs, saunas or hard workouts for 24 hours
Sunscreen on any exposed treated skin
